title: PHP Core Undergoes Security Audit – Results Now Available
content:
A focused security audit of the PHP source code () was recently completed, commissioned by the , organized by in partnership with , and performed by . The audit targeted the most critical parts of the codebase, leading to 27 findings, 17 with security implications, including four CVEs. php/php-srcSovereign Tech AgencyThe PHP FoundationOSTIFQuarkslab

All issues have been addressed by the PHP development team. Users are encouraged to upgrade to the latest PHP versions to benefit from these security improvements.
